label: SafetyComplianceWorkforce process: Plan safety equipment maintenance and upgrades — Request changes and service tickets for protective equipment and engineering controls needed to mitigate hazardous substance exposure.

args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes (Manufacturing Execution), sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

WORKFORCE SAFETY & COMPENSATION:
Agent: sap.sf:agent:OccupationalSafetyComplianceMonitor:v1
- Monitors and automates occupational safety incident tracking and hazard compliance
- Coordinates real-time monitoring of hazardous substances across the workforce
- Automates compliance verification workflows, processes incident reports
- Triggers corrective actions/escalations based on incident severity and hazard classifications
- Related entity types: HazardousSubstance, Incident, SafetyIncident

Agent: sap.ehs:agent:IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1 ✓ BEST FIT for SafetyComplianceWorkforce maintenance planning
- Coordinates safety incident workflows and automates emergency response actions
- Routes service tickets to appropriate response teams
- Processes incident severity assessments
- Tracks equipment status during emergency situations
- Related entity types: ChangeRequest, ITEquipment, ServiceTicket
- Line of Business: Safety and Environment
- BEST for: Planning safety equipment maintenance/upgrades & requesting service tickets for protective equipment & engineering controls

Agent: sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1
- Autonomously analyzes safety incidents to identify root causes
- Recommends corrective and preventive actions prioritized by risk severity

Agent: sap.sf:agent:CompensationPolicyAutomationEngine:v1
- Automates compensation adjustments per organizational policies

WORKFORCE ALLOCATION & PAYROLL:
Agent: sap.sf:agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1
- Automates workforce capability alignment with project resource requirements

ENGINEERING & CHANGE MANAGEMENT:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1
- Automates engineering change processing and material lifecycle coordination

Agent: sap.ehs:agent:SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1
- Automates safety validation across engineering changes, materials, product items
- Coordinates supplier qualification and compliance remediation

ORDER-TO-PRODUCTION:
Agent: sap.s4:agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine:v1
- Captures incoming customer orders from sales opportunities

BOM COMPLIANCE & VALIDATION:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1 (PLM)
Agent: sap.s4:agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent:v1 (S4)
Agent: my.mes:agent:BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator:v1

MANUFACTURING CHANGE:
Agent: my.mes:agent:ProductionChangeOrchestrator:v1
- Automates engineering changes across production materials/items

QUALITY MONITORING:
Agent: my.mes:agent:ProductionQualityMonitor:v1
- Monitors QualityInspection outcomes, detects deviations, initiates escalation workflows
